name: Fraction arithmetic
description: Add, subtract, multiply, divide and simplify fractions, with mixed numbers.
solve: function solve(q){const g=(a,b)=>b?g(b,a%b):Math.abs(a);const red=([n,d])=>{if(d<0){n=-n;d=-d}const k=g(n,d)||1;return[n/k,d/k]};const t=q.toLowerCase().replace(/plus/g,'+').replace(/minus/g,'-').replace(/times|×/g,'*').replace(/divided by|÷/g,':');const F=/(-?\d+)\s+(\d+)\s*\/\s*(\d+)|(-?\d+)\s*\/\s*(\d+)|(-?\d+)/g;const toks=[];let m,last=0;const ops=[];const s=t.replace(/simplify|what is|what's|=|\?/g,' ');const re=/((?:-?\d+\s+)?\d+\s*\/\s*\d+|-?\d+)\s*([+\-*:])?/g;while(m=re.exec(s)){const v=m[1].trim();let f;const mm=v.match(/^(-?\d+)\s+(\d+)\s*\/\s*(\d+)$/);if(mm){const w=+mm[1];f=[w*+mm[3]+(w<0?-1:1)*+mm[2],+mm[3]]}else if(/\//.test(v)){const p=v.split('/');f=[+p[0],+p[1]]}else f=[+v,1];toks.push(f);if(m[2])ops.push(m[2]);else break}if(!toks.length||toks.some(f=>!f[1]))return{answer:null,reason:'Couldn’t read the fractions.'};let r=toks[0];const steps=[];for(let i=1;i<toks.length;i++){const b=toks[i],o=ops[i-1];const before=r;r=o==='+'?[r[0]*b[1]+b[0]*r[1],r[1]*b[1]]:o==='-'?[r[0]*b[1]-b[0]*r[1],r[1]*b[1]]:o==='*'?[r[0]*b[0],r[1]*b[1]]:[r[0]*b[1],r[1]*b[0]];r=red(r);steps.push(`${before[0]}/${before[1]} ${o===':'?'÷':o} ${b[0]}/${b[1]} = ${r[0]}/${r[1]}`)}r=red(r);const whole=Math.trunc(r[0]/r[1]),rem=Math.abs(r[0]%r[1]);return{answer:`${r[0]}/${r[1]}${r[1]===1?'':whole&&rem?` (${whole} ${rem}/${r[1]})`:''} ≈ ${+(r[0]/r[1]).toFixed(6)}`,steps:steps.length?steps:[`Divide top and bottom by ${g(toks[0][0],toks[0][1])}`]}}
